name: env0
summary: env0 runs infrastructure deployments with remote plan, remote apply and remote state storage. Its pricing page lists a free tier with 250 runs a month, and its paid tiers, Cloud Navigator and Cloud Pilot, are sold by quote.

facts.text: Pricing page: Remote Plan and Remote Apply are listed as features. It does not say which paid tier includes each feature.
Remote State Storage and Self-hosted Remote State are listed as features on the pricing page, with the same plan-mapping gap.
The Free tier allows 250 runs a month, 30 active environments, one concurrent run and one self-hosted runner.
Once the monthly run cap is reached on the Free tier, scheduled runs such as TTL destroys and drift detection are skipped until the next cycle.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.unit: forever, up to 250 runs a month
plans.notes: 30 active environments, one concurrent run and a 20-minute maximum run duration.

plans.name: Cloud Navigator
plans.notes: Contact sales. The page offers a Get a free quote button.

plans.name: Cloud Pilot
plans.notes: Contact sales. The page mentions a Proof-of-Value Guarantee without details.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not name a currency for any plan.
The page has a Start Free link, but it gives no trial length or terms.
